brief: North Macedonia's supervised-entity register landscape is almost entirely centralised at the National Bank (НБРСМ/NBRNM), which under the 2022 Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems maintains statutory public registers for payment institutions, e-money institutions and payment system operators, alongside longstanding lists of licensed banks, savings houses, exchange offices (менувачници) and fast-money-transfer providers. All of these are HTML pages with occasional XLS/PDF attachments — no open-data API or archived history was found — and nbrm.mk answered a plain fetch with HTTP 403, so collection needs a browser-grade fetcher plus self-maintained snapshots for change detection. Secondary and cross-checking registers sit at the Central Registry (corporate identity), the Ministry of Finance (financial companies, unreachable this pass), the Deposit Insurance Fund (compulsory membership), the AML office UFR (obliged-entity taxonomies) and the Macedonian Banking Association (membership plus early sector notices). The main open items are the exact landing URL of the payment-institution register itself, whether agents/distributors are separately registered, and an Official Gazette route for dated licence grant/revocation events.
